items.title: Iran war: Tehran vows response to US seizure of cargo ship
items.description: US Marines have seized an Iranian-flagged cargo ship near the Hormuz Strait, President Trump has said. Earlier, he threatened to destroy every bridge and power plant in Iran if no peace deal was reached. DW has more.
